332/1226
Field
Description
CloudRequestId
CloudRequestId is an identifier provided by the cloud whenrequesting action from the sensor; the sensor acknowledges the
request with a CloudRequestReceived event.
ConfigStateHash
Murmur3-32 Hash of ConfigStateUpdate table csv from ConfigState; comparable between sensors only within a CID as channel
versions are not unique or portable across CIDs.
ConfigStateIndex
Deprecated Non-cloudable static field that is SMEnhanced to contain the number 1; prior to SMEnhancer understanding
immediate values needed to index into the appropriate RuntimeSystemTable entry
SensorRequestId
Identifier provided by the sensor when requesting action from the cloud The cloud echos back the SensorRequestId where
appropriate
Entitlements
Bitfield of Cloud relevant Entitlements for the SKU that this sensor is currently licensed for; Sensor relevant entitlements are
stored in SystemTable Tags. The value is set by the cloud and only has meaning to the cloud.The value is totally opaque to the
sensor. There won’t be any #define or similar info relating to this field in sensor code. It is sent to the cloud by the sensor for
efficiency, because the cloud can’t afford to look up sensor(aid) specific entitlements for every arriving event.
EffectiveTransmissionClass
Field representing the effective transmission class
BoundingState
Indicates the bounding decision for a cloudable eventValuesUNBOUNDED (0)BOUNDED (1)
BoundingLimitCount
Aggregate threshold for a given event type; thisfield is present on an event only after a bounding threshold has been
exceeded. It signals an imminent end to transmission of this type of event.For events containing a UPID field, this threshold
count is usually applied per-process. Transmission might restart under various conditions. Some events have their threshold
count raised, if they are, or become, a Detect-Tree (TreeId field is set). Rate limited events might restart after the time interval
indicated by BoundingLimitDuration expires. There are also SystemTags that might change bounding behavior for some event
types.
EventOrigin
If set, this field should be non-zero, to indicate whether it is aBaseline (bit-0), Detect (bit-1), or Experiment (bit-7-34).bits 2-
6/35-63 are spare.If this field doesn’t exist on an event, it is equivalent to having the value 1, indicating a pure Baseline
event.An event can be both Baseline and Detect at the same time, if a process is part of a detect, but hasn’t exceeded the
baseline limits for the event. It could also be Baseline and in one or more experiments simultaneously.ValuesBASELINE (0x1) -
Sent while within ordinary baseline bounding limitsDETECT (0x2) - Sent while UPID was in a DetectCROWDSCORE (0x4) -
Relevant to CrowdScore analysisTRIGGER (0x8) - OverwatchTrigger/CrowdscoreTrigger Incident eventsUNBOUNDED (0x10) -
SysPolicy tag directed unboundingEXPERIMENT1 (0x100) - sent due to experiment-1EXPERIMENT2 (0x200) - sent due to
experiment-2EXPERIMENT3 (0x400) - sent due to experiment-3EXPERIMENT4 (0x800) - sent due to experiment-
4EXPERIMENT5 (0x1000) - sent due to experiment-5EXPERIMENT6 (0x2000) - sent due to experiment-6
BoundingLimitDuration
The duration window in milliseconds during which an aggregate threshold applies for a given event type. Thisfield appears in
conjunction with BoundingLimitCount.The duration represented by the value of this field goes intoeffect at a point determined
by the respective bounding algorithm.Some 24h timers are tied to sensor load-time, other algorithms start timing from the first
instance of the event.
AnnotationData
Arbitrary data attached to those events that are associated or interesting to an Integration(Annotation) Vendor
Tactic
Field representing the MITRE Tactic name or identifier and used to label events related to a MITRE classified activityCurrently
this universal field isn’t used or referenced in the Sensor. It is only of use to the Cloud.
Technique
Field representing the MITRE Technique name or identifier and used to label events related to a MITRE classified
activityCurrently this universal field isn’t used or referenced in the Sensor. It is only of use to the Cloud.
FieldReference
Universal field for representing field references within events
